name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Rosewood goes with exactly one of Nadia, French, or Slav.
Between Sacrifice and Marble, one goes with French and the other with Pirc.
Either French goes with Pin, or Slav goes with Sacrifice — but not both.
If someone in the King's-Pawn Camp goes with Sacrifice, then Slav goes with Magnus.
Either Magnus goes with Pin or Nadia goes with Marble.

hints.text: Suppose Slav went with Pin — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Slav goes with Pin.
Slav goes with Pin, so it can't also go with Sacrifice.
Pin goes with Slav, so French can't go with Pin.
…but now the clue “Either French goes with Pin, or Slav goes with Sacrifice — but not both” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Slav does not go with Pin.

Sacrifice goes with Slav, so French can't go with Sacrifice.
Sacrifice goes with Slav, so Pirc can't go with Sacrifice.
…but now the clue “Between Sacrifice and Marble, one goes with French and the other with Pirc” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Slav does not go with Sacrifice.
